name_input: LEAF CLEANTECH PRIVATE LIMITED; LEAF CLEANTECH PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: Bengaluru (Peenya Industrial Area, #371 & 372, 10th cross, 4th phase) industrial enzyme manufacturer/formulator, site states est. 2010, '15+ yrs'. Real product lines per own catalogue: (1) Food & Nutrition enzymes — bromelain, papain, acid protease, neutral protease, fungal alpha-amylase, glucoamylase, cellulase, hemicellulase, xylanase, pectinase, beta-glucanase, alpha-galactosidase, invertase, lactase (beta-galactosidase), lipase, customised enzyme blends (leafcleantech.com/food-nutrition-products/); (2) Animal Feed enzymes — LEAFPAP AP papain, acid protease, alpha-galactosidase, beta-glucanase, cellulase, lipase (pancreatic), neutral protease, pectinase, xylanase, LEAFMULTI AP poultry cocktail (leafcleantech.com/animal-feed-products/); (3) Fermentation — LEAFALFA L high-temp bacterial alpha-amylase, glucoamylase liquid, LEAFALCO YEAST / LEAFALCO YEAST-M active dry yeast, BOOSTERZYME, MOLZYME, LEAFFERM J/F/S (leafcleantech.com/fermentation-products/). Packaging stated as 25 kg HDPE drums, 1/10/25 kg metallised pouches. No pharma-grade API, no sterile medicaments and no plastic packaging articles are shown anywhere on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims 'industrial enzyme manufacturer' with own brand names (LEAF*), but the catalogue also resells generic items (active dry yeast, pancreatic lipase, papain latex) typical of a formulator/blender + distributor; no plant/equipment evidence published.
comment: HS mapping vs declaration: 3507.90 (enzymes; papain, bromelain, amylase, protease, xylanase, pectinase, lactase, invertase, lipase, glucoamylase) — EXACT match, this is the core of the business and is corroborated by the product catalogue. 3002.49 (other blood fractions/immunological products, vaccines, cultures of micro-organisms) — WRONG/unsupported: nothing on the site is a blood fraction, immunological product, vaccine or microbial culture; the closest items are active dry yeast (Saccharomyces), which belongs to 2102.10 (active yeasts) — not 3002.49. 3923.10 (boxes/cases of plastics) — WRONG/unsupported: the site mentions HDPE drums and metallised pouches only as PACKAGING of its own enzymes, not as traded goods; if packaging were traded, drums would be 3923.30 and pouches 3923.21, not 3923.10. Missing from the declaration: 3504.00 (peptones/protein hydrolysates — implied by 'protein hydrolysis'/'hydrolysates' applications, weak), 2102.10 (active dry yeast LEAFALCO YEAST / YEAST-M — a real, separately priced product line, 10 kg packs, MOQ 100 kg), 2309.90 (preparations of a kind used in animal feeding — the LEAFMULTI AP feed cocktail and feed-grade enzyme premixes are arguably feed preparations rather than pure enzymes; depends on formulation), 3824.99 (chemical preparations n.e.s. — customised enzyme blends). Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — the company is a biotechnology / industrial enzymes / food-feed-fermentation ingredients supplier; no oil & gas products at all. Trader signs: resold generic catalogue items (active dry yeast, pancreatic lipase, papaya latex papain) alongside own LEAF* brands; 'manufacturer' claim not independently corroborated. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, code corrected to 3507.90 as primary with 2102.10 / 2309.90 / 3824.99 as secondary, and 3002.49 + 3923.10 dropped. All product data above is from the company's own website — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed). Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and shipment history: null — not researched here and not public on the site.
